passages.text: Our family visits Grandfather's farm at the beginning of spring. He works his land each year to grow vegetables for the nearby town. On the first planting day, every family member helps with one row. Grandfather says this is a family tradition that his parents taught him. My aunt shows me how to leave enough space between the young plants. After our work, we sit together and listen to stories about earlier planting days. I understand that growing food also gives our family a way to share time and stories.

parallelText.en: Our family visits Grandfather's farm at the beginning of spring.
parallelText.zh: 春天开始时，我们一家拜访爷爷的农场。

parallelText.en: He works his land each year to grow vegetables for the nearby town.
parallelText.zh: 他每年耕种土地，为附近的小镇种蔬菜。

parallelText.en: On the first planting day, every family member helps with one row.
parallelText.zh: 第一天栽种时，每位家庭成员帮忙种一行。

parallelText.en: Grandfather says this is a family tradition that his parents taught him.
parallelText.zh: 爷爷说，这是父母教给他的家庭传统。

parallelText.en: My aunt shows me how to leave enough space between the young plants.
parallelText.zh: 阿姨教我怎样在幼苗之间留出足够间距。

parallelText.en: After our work, we sit together and listen to stories about earlier planting days.
parallelText.zh: 干完活后，我们坐在一起，听以前栽种日的故事。

parallelText.en: I understand that growing food also gives our family a way to share time and stories.
parallelText.zh: 我明白了，种食物也让家人有机会相聚并分享故事。

wordHelp.meaning: a line of plants or objects
putting seeds or young plants into the ground

passages.text: A free reading club opens in the room beside our town library. The local people bring books and offer to read with younger children. These volunteers play an important part in keeping the club open every weekend. One person welcomes new readers while another helps them choose a book. The children can ask questions and try reading a page aloud without feeling rushed. At the end, everyone helps return the books to their shelves. Because people share the jobs, the club becomes a friendly place for the whole town.

parallelText.en: A free reading club opens in the room beside our town library.
parallelText.zh: 一个免费阅读社团在镇图书馆旁的房间开办。

parallelText.en: The local people bring books and offer to read with younger children.
parallelText.zh: 当地人带来书籍，主动陪较小的孩子阅读。

parallelText.en: These volunteers play an important part in keeping the club open every weekend.
parallelText.zh: 这些志愿者在让社团每周末开放方面发挥重要作用。

parallelText.en: One person welcomes new readers while another helps them choose a book.
parallelText.zh: 一人欢迎新读者，另一人帮他们选书。

parallelText.en: The children can ask questions and try reading a page aloud without feeling rushed.
parallelText.zh: 孩子们可以提问，试着大声读一页，不必觉得被催促。

parallelText.en: At the end, everyone helps return the books to their shelves.
parallelText.zh: 结束时，大家帮忙把书放回书架。

parallelText.en: Because people share the jobs, the club becomes a friendly place for the whole town.
parallelText.zh: 因为人们分担工作，社团成了全镇友好的阅读场所。
